question: In the partner-mean arm A0, is the BOSI moment bank (M, n) still load-bearing once the new nonlinear pair-interaction channel Phi is present?

arms.A0: BOSI-B + Phi(pair interaction features), partner-mean variant (no target state)
arms.A0M0: byte-identical to A0, moment block M zeroed at every forward; same capacity, same init

initial_state: A0 and A0M0 are bit-identical per seed
recipe: R0 frozen (AdamW 1e-3 -> 1e-5 cosine, 500 warmup, wd 1e-5, dropout 0, clip 5, batch 128, raw-y L1, 47400 updates, strict min-valid best)

decision_rules.MOMENT_REDUNDANT: mean over seeds of (A0M0 - A0) <= +0.001  -> the moment bank adds nothing given Phi (a 457k-class lean body is the better claim)
decision_rules.MOMENT_ESSENTIAL: mean over seeds of (A0M0 - A0) >= +0.003 -> the two contents are additive; do not remove
decision_rules.AMBIGUOUS: otherwise, or seeds disagree in sign with |mean| < 0.003

tail_guard: report row-172 and drop-top-1-contributor for both seeds
